title: wedelia frustrata
intro: Wedelia frustrata, commonly known as the bitter wedelia or bitter joy, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia frustrata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia frustrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
